description: Na₈Hf(MoO₄)₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.42-2.79 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five MoO₄ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.51 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.55 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one HfO₆ octahedra, corners with five MoO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.62 Å. Hf is bonded to six O atoms to form HfO₆ octahedra that share corners with six MoO₄ tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Hf-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.11 Å. There are three inequivalent Mo sites. In the first Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one HfO₆ octahedra and corners with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 36°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.86 Å. In the second Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one HfO₆ octahedra and corners with three NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 43°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.77-1.87 Å. In the third Mo site, Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one HfO₆ octahedra and corners with four NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 42°. There are three shorter (1.78 Å) and one longer (1.88 Å) Mo-O bond length. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Hf and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one Mo atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Hf, and one Mo atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one Mo atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mo atom.
